Crawl multiple pages with depth=1 and WARC output enabled

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"max_depth\":1,\"respect_robots_txt\":false,\"warc_output\":\"/tmp/crawlberg_crawl.warc\"}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.crawl(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.pages().count)
debugPrint(result.stayedOnDomain())
```
